The '''Dawnstone Plans''' are blacksmithing plans drafted by the late Gilnean smith [[Adaman]] that are located inside [[Adaman Armor]] in [[Gilneas City]]. His old friend [[Therum Deepforge]] asked adventurers to retrieve them so that his findings could be properly recorded in both Stormwind and Ironforge.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|41D|Behind The Wall}}</ref>

==Objective of==
Contains [[Dawnstone Plans]] for the quest {{questlong|Alliance|41D|Behind The Wall}}.
